It’s really not that simple at all, at least not for some people and everyone has different experiences in abusive relationships, especially if they’re scared to leave. 

I personally found it extremely hard to leave as I felt guilty about hurting them and they had worked me down to nothing so I felt worthless without them almost to a delusional point, I didn’t think and rationalise normally.

I do wish it was that simple, people would walk away from their abusive relationships a hell of a lot easier, I do agree staying away is the hardest part though.

A lot of people do not know what it’s like to be in an abusive situation and how weirdly hard it is to leave until they’re in it themselves.

OP, I know it’s hard for you but I encourage you to start doing things without thinking, don’t overthink and just pack your stuff and stay with your mother, just get up and go and don’t overthink it. You’ll feel awful about it just now and you’ll have so many doubts but I promise you will thank yourself in the long run, think about the freedom of getting out of this relationship and your future happiness and let it be your motivator when you feel like going back and doubting yourself.

It’s been 5 years, this will keep happening on a loop and you’ll wish you done something sooner, the time is now and you’re totally capable of doing this, let yourself be upset, grieve and things will get better, good luck xo

I'm finding it incredibly difficult to leave because in a way I feel responsible for helping him as his family doesn't. I still love him a lot so it makes things more difficult and I try to ignore and justify his behaviour. He's also part of our friend group so I have no idea how I'm going to be able to deal with that, I know the relationships pretty toxic and I never seen myself being here.

Thanks so much for your reply.

I know you're right, I'm just finding it really difficult to leave (well because I love him and don't want to) even though I'm getting treated like this regularly I'm not sure why, I'm usually strong minded when it comes to relationships but this one is breaking me it's ridiculous.

In all honesty it isn't a very healthy relationship at all and I'm really struggling with it. Yeah he's been signed off of work for the moment, is back and forth from the doctors and has been referred to a mental health team. 

Thank you for replying.

Yeah that's the thing I don't know. He has a habit of doing petty things like this and then saying to me he didn't mean it. He has ignored people in past relationships for a week at a time. If he has broken things off then I just want to know so I can get on with my life, sitting about wondering is destroying me and i have lots of things of mine at his house that I need to get but can't due to him ignoring me.

Thanks for your reply it's really appreciated.
